content: Today, you're only paying for the selected amount of admins for the remaining days until your billing date. Moving forward, the full amount will be charged once per billing cycle on your regular billing date.

comment.text: Tooltip explaining the "Total due today" amount in the price details dialog: today the user is charged a prorated amount for the added admins for the remaining days of the billing cycle, and the full amount is charged on each subsequent billing date.
